references.text: The chief priests and the scribes react negatively to Jesus' actions and teaching, a similar reaction as in Mark 11:18.
The chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people seek to kill Jesus, mirroring the event in Mark 11:18.
The chief priests and the Pharisees plan to kill Jesus, parallel to the plot against Jesus in Mark 11:18.
The chief priests and the Pharisees gather to find a way to arrest and kill Jesus, reflecting the conspiracy in Mark 11:18.
